admissionRules: The instance must bind to ACCOUNT_REGISTRATION and LEGAL_AUDIT.
The instance must be approved or active before runtime use.
Exactly one deterministic retention rule mode must be present.
The client must not select or override the rule.
The selected policyVersion is persisted immutably on ENT-CONSENT.
No AUTH-001 runtime registration may persist ENT-CONSENT while the applicable policy instance is absent or unresolved.
Approval and provenance must be traceable to a current repository artifact.
nonAuthorizations: The 730-day value is an internally approved engineering production policy, not a jurisdiction-specific legal requirement.
No public privacy notice or compliance representation may treat 730 days as a universal legal mandate without separate legal/compliance review.
No new Worker/D1/Queue or Payload Core change is authorized by this admission.
No Mapping 0 GREEN or Evidence Registry promotion is implied by policy admission alone.

governanceBaseline.boundary: Governance baseline plus an explicitly admitted production engineering policy; legal/jurisdiction-specific interpretation remains outside this artifact and can replace the policy through normal versioned authority.

runtimeAuthorization.development: AUTH-001 development/integration validation may use the same deterministic policy rule.
runtimeAuthorization.authorizationBoundary: Production runtime may use this explicitly admitted engineering policy instance. This does not constitute jurisdiction-specific legal advice or a legal retention mandate.
